pre.description: Pre-flight checks — all scaffolding phases (0-8) complete
pre.procedure: For MLflow checks: run mlflow-procedures.json: check-token-validity first, then mlflow-procedures.json: get-experiment-id. If either fails, MLflow is not reachable — do not proceed to Phase 1.

assertions.description: Logged into OpenShift cluster
OpenShift token is valid (not expired)
tests/behavioral/conftest.py exists (Phase 4 complete)
golden_queries.yaml fixture exists (Phase 4 complete)
thresholds.yaml has agent section (Phase 5 complete)
Agent deployed and reachable (health endpoint returns OK)
assertions.pass_if: curl -sf https://<AGENT_ROUTE>/health returns HTTP 200

assertions.description: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI set to the cluster MLflow instance
assertions.pass_if: Environment variable is set and points to a valid MLflow URL

assertions.description: MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_NAME set
assertions.pass_if: Environment variable is set to a per-agent experiment name (e.g. <namespace>/<deployment-name>). Each agent MUST have a unique experiment name -- a shared name causes MLflow trace cross-contamination (RHAIENG-6743). The run-btests-pytest.sh script auto-detects per-agent names from each deployment.

assertions.description: MLFLOW_WORKSPACE set to the OpenShift namespace
assertions.pass_if: Set to the same namespace as oc project -q

assertions.description: MLFLOW_TRACKING_INSECURE_TLS=true set
assertions.pass_if: Set to true for OpenShift clusters with self-signed certs

assertions.description: Agent URL env var set with correct route
assertions.pass_if: Agent-specific URL env var (e.g. CREWAI_WEBSEARCH_AGENT_URL) is set and points to the deployed OpenShift route

phase-1.description: Pytest behavioral tests passed with MLflow enrichment

assertions.command: uv run --extra test --extra test-mlflow pytest agents/${AGENT_PATH}/tests/behavioral/ --collect-only -q
assertions.description: Test collection succeeds with no import errors or missing fixtures
All collected tests run and pass (exit code 0)
assertions.pass_if: pytest output shows all tests PASSED, exit code 0, no FAILED or ERROR lines

assertions.description: Six MLflow env vars were set in the pytest invocation
assertions.pass_if: The pytest command included MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI, MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_NAME, MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN, MLFLOW_WORKSPACE, MLFLOW_TRACKING_INSECURE_TLS, and agent URL var

assertions.description: No unexpected skipped or xfailed tests
assertions.pass_if: No tests were skipped or xfailed unless documented in the agent README testing section

phase-2.description: HARD GATE: tool_calls came from MLflow traces, not content heuristics

assertions.description: No 'MLflow enrichment failed' warning in test output
assertions.pass_if: pytest output does NOT contain 'MLflow enrichment failed'

assertions.description: No 'tool_calls not exposed in response' warning in test output
assertions.pass_if: pytest output does NOT contain 'tool_calls not exposed in response'

assertions.description: score_tool_selection() ran with F1 scoring
assertions.pass_if: Tool selection tests used F1-based scoring (precision/recall), not content keyword matching. Check that score_tool_selection was called and produced numeric scores.

assertions.description: score_hallucinated_tools() and score_tool_call_validity() executed
assertions.pass_if: Both hallucination and validity scorers ran without error. Check test output for assertion results from these scorers.

assertions.description: tool_calls list is non-empty for tool-triggering queries
assertions.pass_if: For golden queries with expected_tools, the result.tool_calls list was populated (not empty). Check that F1 scores are > 0.

waiver.condition: Phase 2a determined tracing is missing/broken AND a Jira bug was filed under parent epic
waiver.action: Document degraded mode in agent README testing section (Phase 7 item 3), reference the bug ticket, note expected behavior once tracing is fixed

phase-3.procedure: Run mlflow-procedures.json: inspect-span-types to get the full span tree. This is the ONLY way to verify trace structure — do not guess or skip.

assertions.description: TOOL spans exist with names matching agent tool names
assertions.pass_if: inspect-span-types output shows [TOOL] spans. Span names match the agent's defined tool names (from Phase 1 step 2).

assertions.description: CHAT_MODEL spans exist with tokenUsage attributes
assertions.pass_if: inspect-span-types output shows [CHAT_MODEL] spans with tokenUsage values.

assertions.description: Framework-specific spans exist
assertions.pass_if: inspect-span-types output shows framework spans: [CHAIN] for LangGraph/LangChain, [AGENT] for CrewAI, [RETRIEVER] for RAG agents, etc.

assertions.description: Trace hierarchy has expected depth (not flat)
assertions.pass_if: inspect-span-types output shows spans with different parent_id values — not all parent=ROOT. At least 2 levels of nesting.

assertions.description: No MLflow connection errors or auth failures in recent logs
assertions.pass_if: oc logs output does NOT contain 'connection refused', 'auth', '401', '403', or 'MLFLOW' error patterns

assertions.description: Tracing initialization message present
assertions.pass_if: Logs contain evidence of tracing setup: 'tracing enabled', 'MLflow', 'enable_tracing', or similar initialization messages

assertions.description: No span creation failure warnings
assertions.pass_if: Logs do NOT contain 'span', 'trace', or 'export' error/warning messages indicating failed span creation

assertions.description: No unhandled exceptions related to MLflow or tracing
assertions.pass_if: No Python tracebacks or unhandled exception messages related to mlflow, opentelemetry, or tracing modules

assertions.description: conftest.py: _find_repo_root() raises FileNotFoundError, not pytest.skip()
assertions.pass_if: All agents' conftest.py files use raise FileNotFoundError(...) on failure, not pytest.skip(). Read each conftest and verify.

assertions.description: conftest.py: MLflow enrichment uses asyncio.to_thread + try/except + logging.warning() + warnings.warn()
assertions.pass_if: All agents' conftest.py files have all four elements in the MLflow enrichment block: asyncio.to_thread wrapping enrich_eval_result, try/except around it, logging.warning() on failure, and warnings.warn() on failure.

assertions.description: conftest.py: load_golden() function body is identical across agents
assertions.pass_if: The load_golden() function has the same signature (category: str | None = None) and identical YAML loading logic across all agents.

assertions.description: conftest.py: Import block has stdlib separated from third-party (ruff I001)
assertions.pass_if: Standard library imports (asyncio, logging, os, pathlib, warnings) are separated from third-party imports (httpx, pytest, yaml) by a blank line.

assertions.description: conftest.py: run_eval fixture has the same parameter list across agents
assertions.pass_if: The run_eval fixture accepts the same parameters everywhere: query, expected_tools, timeout_seconds, max_tokens_budget, model, stream.

assertions.description: All four test files exist: test_tool_usage.py, test_response_quality.py, test_cost_latency.py, test_reliability.py
Each test file uses pytestmark = pytest.mark.<agent_marker>; reliability also includes pytest.mark.slow
assertions.pass_if: Every test file has a pytestmark assignment with the agent's marker. test_reliability.py includes both the agent marker and pytest.mark.slow.

assertions.description: Scorer imports are consistent across agents
assertions.pass_if: test_tool_usage.py imports score_tool_selection, score_hallucinated_tools, score_tool_call_validity. test_response_quality.py and test_reliability.py import score_plan_coherence. test_cost_latency.py imports score_latency.

assertions.description: Core test functions match the existing pattern
assertions.pass_if: Test function names may vary (single-tool vs multi-tool agents), but scorer usage and assertion structure are the same as other agents.

assertions.description: All test functions use the run_eval fixture — no direct HTTP calls
assertions.pass_if: Every test function uses the run_eval fixture for agent interaction. No test makes direct httpx/requests calls to the agent URL.

assertions.description: golden_queries.yaml uses the standard schema
assertions.pass_if: fixtures/golden_queries.yaml has queries[] with keys: query, expected_tools, expected_elements, difficulty, category.

assertions.description: thresholds.yaml agent section has the same keys as other agents
assertions.pass_if: Agent section has: tool_selection_accuracy, response_coherence_accuracy, max_latency_p95, pass_at_k — plus multi_tool_accuracy if agent has multi-tool scenarios. Keys match other agents.

assertions.description: Phase 6: Validation report generated and committed
assertions.pass_if: BTEST_VALIDATION_REPORT_<agent_name>.md was written to tests/behavioral/reports/ with all assertion results filled in (no remaining [ ] placeholders)

assertions.description: Jira ticket updated with results summary
assertions.pass_if: The Jira ticket was updated with a comment summarizing validation results, including which gates passed/failed/waived

assertions.description: Definition of Done: test artifacts exist
